clips.title: The story
paras: At Garren's Haunt, Maggot Eye's Paw proves the gnoll chieftain is dead. The paw is carried to Brill as proof of his execution for stealing corpses for the Scourge.

Maggot Eye raided graves and pillaged the countryside near Garren's Haunt, supplying corpses to the Lich King's armies. The Forsaken posted a death sentence and bounty in Brill. To collect the bounty and close it, hunters must bring the gnoll's severed paw back to town. Executor Zygand accepts that proof in place of rumors of Maggot Eye's death.
